name: HCD State Income Limits
claim: The current California State Income Limits are the 2026 limits revised June 23, 2026. Orange County area median income for 4 people is $138,600; low income (80%) for 4 is $148,850.

name: CalHFA homebuyer programs
claim: CalHFA offers MyHome Assistance (deferred junior loan up to 3.5% with FHA or 3% conventional), CalPLUS with ZIP, and MyAccess. Forgivable Equity Builder and the Extra Credit Teacher Program are not currently listed.

name: CalHFA Dream For All
claim: Dream For All offers up to 20% of the price (max $150,000) as a shared-appreciation loan for first-generation buyers. The 2026 round is closed and no 2027 round has been announced.

name: County of Orange Mortgage Assistance Program
claim: The County of Orange Mortgage Assistance Program offers up to $80,000 as a deferred silent second at 3% simple interest for first-time buyers at or below 80% AMI. Whether it is open in 2026 is unclear.

name: Orange County Mortgage Credit Certificate
claim: The Orange County Mortgage Credit Certificate program is available and currently funded, administered by National Homebuyers Fund.

name: Garden Grove First-Time Home Buyer Program
claim: Garden Grove offers up to $110,000 (low income) or $50,000 (moderate income) as a 0% deferred 30-year loan for first-time buyers; at least 3% down.

name: Santa Ana My First Home
claim: Santa Ana's My First Home program offers up to $120,000 as a 0% deferred second loan for first-time buyers, with up to $40,000 forgivable for veterans and qualifying local graduates.

name: Anaheim homebuyer assistance
claim: Anaheim has a first-time homebuyer loan of about $50,000 (amount and status unclear).

name: Habitat for Humanity OC qualifications
claim: Habitat OC serves households from about $55,850 to $166,300 (4 people), requires 200–500 sweat-equity hours, 1–5% down plus closing costs, and that applicants live or work in Orange County.

name: GSFA Platinum
claim: GSFA Platinum offers down payment assistance up to about 5–5.5% of the first loan, with a Select option that adds a gift for law enforcement, firefighters, EMTs, health care workers, and education staff. First mortgage limit $832,750.

name: FHLBank San Francisco WISH
claim: FHLBank San Francisco WISH provides matching down payment grants for first-time buyers at or below 80% AMI through member banks.

name: OC Housing Authority homeownership
claim: The Orange County Housing Authority runs a Housing Choice Voucher homeownership option for current voucher holders who are first-time buyers.

name: LAO: Proposition 1 (2026)
claim: Proposition 1 (Nov 3, 2026) authorizes $10 billion for affordable housing plus $1.25 billion for veterans' home loans; early returns show it passing.

name: LAO: Proposition 37 (2026)
claim: Proposition 37 lets CalHFA offer loans up to 17% of the price of newly built homes for buyers up to 2x area median income; not yet available.

name: SchoolsFirst FCU mortgage rates
claim: SchoolsFirst's School Employee Special (no PMI, 3% down) is 7.125% rate / 7.19% APR at 0 points, HomeAccess first-time buyer 7.000% / 7.37% APR, and FHA (620 score) 7.000% / 7.78% APR, as of 2026-11-07.

name: Orange County's Credit Union home loan rates
claim: Orange County's Credit Union 30-year fixed is 6.875% rate / 7.063% APR with 0.625 points (780 score, 60% loan-to-value), as of 2026-11-06.

name: Navy Federal mortgage rates
claim: Navy Federal Homebuyers Choice (0% down, 720 score) is 7.375% / 7.713% APR with 0.5 points; VA 30-year is 6.000% / 6.48% APR with 1 point, as of 2026-11-07.
